panel.title: Notifications
panel.errorBody: Check the connection and try again. No notification is lost.
panel.emptyHint: Assignments, date reminders, changes to records you follow, finished imports and automation messages show here.

disabledReason.circuit_breaker: Its runs failed 50 times in a row, or it was triggered more than 100 times in a minute.
disabledReason.run_as_lost_access: The person it runs as no longer has the access it needs.

item.overflow: Automation «{{name}}» skipped records of a bulk change
item.overflowUnnamed: An automation skipped records of a bulk change
item.overflowBody: It runs at most {{limit}} times for one batch of changes.
item.lostRecord: No longer allowed to view the record
item.lostAutomation: No longer allowed to view the automation
item.lostBase: No longer allowed to open the base
item.followedChangedRecordsFields_one: {{actor}} changed {{fields}} on {{formatted}} record you follow in {{table}}
item.followedChangedRecordsFields_other: {{actor}} changed {{fields}} on {{formatted}} records you follow in {{table}}
item.overflowSkipped_one: {{formatted}} record of the batch got no run. It runs at most {{limit}} times for one batch of changes.
item.overflowSkipped_other: {{formatted}} records of the batch got no run. It runs at most {{limit}} times for one batch of changes.
item.lostTable: No longer allowed to view the table

records.none: You can no longer view these records.

report.gone: The error report is no longer available: it is kept for 24 hours, for the person who ran the import.

message.name: Messages from automations
message.description: Content an automation writes and sends to you.

disabled.name: Automation turned itself off
disabled.description: In-app is always on so that you know when an automation stops running.

batch_overflow.name: Automation skipped records of a bulk change
batch_overflow.description: When one batch goes past the limit of runs.

assigned.name: Assigned to records
assigned.description: When someone assigns you through a person field with “Notify people when they are assigned”. A bulk change (paste, import) sends one notification for all its records.

followed_changed.name: Changes to records you follow
followed_changed.description: When someone else changes a record you follow (changes within a minute are grouped). Only fields you can see are listed; bulk changes such as pastes and imports are not sent.

finished.name: Import finished
finished.description: When an import of a CSV or Excel file you started ends: succeeded, failed or cancelled.

reminder.name: Date reminders
reminder.description: When the date of a field with a reminder comes due (for example 09:00 the day before, in the field’s time zone). Sent to the people the reminder names, only for records and fields you can see.

settings.title: Notifications
settings.subtitle: Your settings in {{org}}. Every notification email links to this page.

email.title: Notification emails
email.description: How often notification emails are sent to you.
email.immediateHint: Notifications within 5 minutes go in one email.
email.offHint: No notification email. Notifications still show in the app.

types.title: Notification types
types.description: Choose the channels of each type.
types.caption: Notification types by channel

muted.title: Muted bases
muted.description: Mute a base from its “…” menu in the sidebar.
muted.effect: Muted bases send no email; their notifications still show in the app. “Automation turned itself off” is always sent.

noSmtp.title: The email channel is not available
noSmtp.body: The Cellhive email server is not configured, so the Email column and the email frequency are hidden. Notifications still show in the app.

saved.immediate: Saved: emails as notifications come (grouped every 5 minutes).
saved.daily: Saved: a daily summary email at {{time}}.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.description: Receive your notifications in a private chat with the organization's Telegram bot.
telegram.intro: Link your Telegram account to receive notifications in a private chat with the organization's bot. Choose which types go to Telegram in the table below.
telegram.unavailable: Telegram notifications are not turned on in this organization yet. Ask an organization owner or admin to choose a notification bot.
telegram.unavailableAdmin: Telegram notifications are not turned on in this organization yet: choose a notification bot first.
telegram.linkedHint: Notifications go to your private chat with the bot. Sending /stop to the bot also unlinks.

reason.blocked: Telegram refused to deliver to you: you may have blocked {{bot}} or deleted the chat. Unblock the bot if needed, then link again.
reason.bot_changed: The organization changed its notification bot. Link again, this time with {{bot}}.
reason.unknown: Telegram notifications cannot reach you. Link again.

telegram.stepOpen: Scan the QR code with your phone's camera, or open Telegram on this computer.
telegram.stepOpenPhone: Open Telegram with the button below.
telegram.stepStart: Press Start in the chat with {{bot}}.
telegram.waiting: Waiting for you to press Start… this page updates by itself.
telegram.qrLabel: QR code of the link to {{bot}} on Telegram
telegram.expired: The link expired before it was used. Create a new one when you are ready.
telegram.pendingElsewhere: A link created in another tab or device is waiting. Use it there, or create a new one here.
telegram.columnNote: The Telegram column applies once you link Telegram.

announce.waiting: Link created. Open it in Telegram and press Start.
announce.error: Telegram notifications can no longer reach you.

confirm.title: Unlink Telegram?
confirm.description: You will stop receiving notifications on Telegram. You can link again at any time.

follow.title: Following records
follow.description: You are told when someone else changes a record you follow (“Changes to records you follow”).
follow.createdHint: When you create one record by hand. Not pastes, imports, forms or automations.
follow.assigned: Follow records I am assigned to
follow.assignedHint: When someone adds you to a person field that notifies people. You are still notified of the assignment when this is off.
follow.effect: Turning a switch off only stops new follows: the records you follow stay followed. Unfollow a record from its detail panel.

shell.disabledToastUnnamed: An automation just turned itself off.
shell.mutedToast: «{{name}}» is muted: no notification emails for it. In-app notifications still show.
